description: This file defines the interface for an HttpClient class used for HTTP operations such as downloading files, setting rate limits, and managing SSL configurations. It also includes a utility class for tracing function entry and exit.

classes.name: HttpClient
classes.description: A class providing HTTP client functionalities including file download, rate limiting, and SSL configuration.

classes.name: trace_exit
classes.description: A utility class for tracing function entry and exit for debugging purposes.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Downloads a file from the specified URL to a local filename with optional rate limiting.

methods.name: setRateLimit
methods.description: Sets the maximum receive speed for the HTTP transfer.

methods.name: getProgress
methods.description: Returns the current progress of the transfer.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Sets the authentication token for SSL (currently a placeholder).

methods.name: setCert
methods.description: Sets the SSL certificate (currently a placeholder).

methods.name: setCertPath
methods.description: Sets the path to the SSL certificate (currently a placeholder).

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the last request.

methods.name: progressCb
methods.description: Static callback for tracking progress during transfer.

methods.name: write_data
methods.description: Static callback for writing received data to a file.

methods.name: trace_exit
methods.description: A utility class for tracing function entry and exit.
